article_limitations: Retrospective case series: only Table 2 gives individual-level values (age, sex, IV and SC months, PASI, DLQI, total treatment time); there is no narrative per patient and no individual dates.
Cohort statements (means, 81% or 81.8% PASI no-worsening, DLQI improvement in 100%, PGA 8:3 and 10:1, TSQM-9 scores) are not copied to individuals; individual PGA and TSQM-9 values are not reported.

Statements that explicitly cover all patients (moderate to severe plaque psoriasis vulgaris, IV-IFX 5 mg/kg, failed traditional systemic therapy, self-administered SC-IFX for 12 months, full compliance, at least 12 months follow-up, no adverse reactions) are recorded for each patient with that wording in the evidence.
Table 2 total treatment time for the row with IV 9 and SC 12 months prints 22 rather than 21; kept as printed and flagged review_only.

The abstract says DLQI improved in 100% of patients, but Table 2 lists one patient with DLQI 0 under both IV and SC; the text also cites Table 1 for PASI scores that appear in the table labelled Table 2, and Figure 1B for TSQM percentages that belong to Figure 2B. None reconciled.
PASI and DLQI assessment timepoints are given only at cohort level (SC initiation and 48 weeks, TSQM-9 at end of IV and after 12 months SC); individual cells carry no timepoint.
Caption-layer visual status is not_inspected; the three charts are inspected in the visual submission.

Patients are numbered by first mention: Table 2 ID 4 is individually named in the methods text (comorbid psoriatic arthritis) before the table, so it is p1; Table 2 IDs 1-3 are p2-p4 and IDs 5-11 keep p5-p11.
Figure 1B DLQI bars (read about 2.6 for IV and about 0.4 for SC) do not match the Table 2 DLQI means (4.27 and 0.00) or the text value 0.00 after switching; not reconciled.
